identification: Victorian Australian red cedar two-height cottage bookcase / chiffonier-bookcase, c1860-70: upper case with moulded cornice and two arched glazed doors over two adjustable shelves; open shelf-back with turned columns on a chiffonier base with a single cushion-moulded frieze drawer over two arched-panel doors and a plinth. Timber reads as solid red cedar throughout, including interior back boards and shelves (warm pinkish-brown, open grain), not mahogany veneer. Plain provincial piece, not a fine library bookcase. 201 x 109 x 50 cm per catalogue.

Check dealer asking at Antiques Online / Trove-style sites 'cedar cottage bookcase'.
viewing_check: Confirm red cedar throughout (back boards, drawer linings and secondary timbers; pine secondaries are fine). Check top and base are original to each other (same timber, colour, screw holes). Look for a split or patched top, replaced glass or beading, woodworm, and that the drawer runs. Measure.
